## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is `feature/`, `bugfix/`, `docs/` or `chore/<slug>` from `develop`, and the title is a Conventional Commit (CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Operation changes come with shared vectors, and the Python and TypeScript cores agree.
- [ ] Tests, docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated.
- [ ] Third-party code or data has an entry in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] No existing file under `assets/branding/source/` or `assets/docs/` is changed or deleted, or the PR has the `assets-change-approved` label.
